header.author: fable
header.purpose: second author-disjoint held-out set for FOCUS-3 message-level ADMISSION: standing rule vs one-off request / quoted or reported text / data payload; domains, scenarios and messages disjoint from fable-admission-heldout.jsonl

field_notes.standing_rules: verbatim spans with 0-based [start,end) character offsets into message; empty when the message admits nothing; tool/assistant rows never carry rules
field_notes.one_off_request: true when the message asks for a piece of work on data it carries, or carries a single-reply-scoped constraint; formal 'Process request for task X ... after applying the active rule' templates are one-off requests with zero standing rules
field_notes.quoted_or_reported: true when rule-shaped text is quoted, reported, hypothetical, fictional, tool/assistant-authored, or a hedged proposal
field_notes.scenario: sc-<domain>-<topic>; variants of one scenario (rule / payload / quoted / rule+payload / tool or assistant echo) share the id

header.data_lineage: hand-written by fable in this session with no access to focus3-gate banks, the benchmark directory under data/, or any enrichment data; evaluated-on only; never to be used for model fitting, selection, or tuning
header.provenance: sentences, spans, keys, scopes, labels, rationales and scenario ids hand-written; character offsets and counts computed mechanically from the verbatim spans and asserted unique
